request.prompt:

Both references are the SAME southeast front-three-quarter camera facing lower-right. Reference A is the START pose, reference B the END pose of one short quarter-step interval. Do not introduce any opposite support pose. Keep head angle, tiny-child proportions, chestnut ponytail/gold crown, red-gold flame robe, ivory cuffs, yin-yang belt, black baggy trousers and goldred shoes exactly. RIGHT hand has one red talisman fan, LEFT hand has one brass bell. Follow gentle arm/clothing movement from A to B. Each complete figure about89% of equal square cell height; uniform scale and margins, no clipped hair or props. Flat #FF00FF background. No labels, lines, shadows, effects or floor.

Cell1 right boot nearly flat, left heel just off ground; cell2 right boot flat under weight, left boot gently lifted behind; cell3 left knee bends and raised left boot moves near planted ankle; cell4 almost B. No support switch, no airborne right foot, exactly two legs. Safe empty margins in every quadrant including top of lower-row ponytails.
